bayts.text: O One (Al-Aḥad), bless and grant peace for ever upon him whom You named Muḥammad.
O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ), bless and grant peace for ever upon the intimate friend and beloved Aḥmad.
O Benefactor, bless and grant peace at all times upon Your Prophet, chief of the righteous.
O One, bless and grant peace eternally upon Your Messenger, lamp of whoever worships.
O Gentle (Al-Laṭīf), bless for ever and grant peace upon Your intimate friend, the desire of the learned.
O Gentle, bless for ever, with peace, Your lamp that dispelled the darkness.
Decree for him, with his Family and the Companions, the best two greetings, and make my path clear.
Grant the Messenger of Allah, in my pens, glad tidings, O You Who erased my blame.
Direct to the most excellent of creation, Muḥammad, from You, the glad tidings of the Generous, the Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad).
Grant the Prophet of Allah, in my pens, a joy that endures, and increase my making-known (of the truth).
To Aḥmad, the Chosen One, convey his wishes, O Doer, Who set him foremost among the trustworthy.
Decree a blessing and a peace whose equal is not seen, for him who removed perplexities.
Grant the Messenger of Allah what has not been and never shall be for any contingent being.
I have written that the Select One has surpassed whoever has passed, whoever will come and whoever is in this time.
The peace of an Everlasting One and a blessing made eternal (be) upon him whose like women have never borne.
Grant the Messenger of Allah, O Lord of power, his desire, without harm or turbidity.
O Lord, O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), grant the Chosen One his wishes without fear.
Pour a blessing escorted by glad tidings, with peace, upon the pride of mankind.
Convey to the Select One a blessing with peace, just as You revealed to him the most excellent of speech.
For Your noble Face make the blessing everlasting, with peace, for him whose loftiness grows.
Convey to Your Chosen One, of wishes, what cannot be counted, O Helper of whoever seeks victory.
O Benefactor, convey to the Prophet what he desires, for You are the Giver Who awakens desire.
Upon Your Messenger, the Prophet Muḥammad, pour blessing and peace for ever, O my Self-Sufficient One.
Decree for him blessing and peace, O best Benign One, Who never ceases to be All-Knowing.
O Allah, bless and grant peace every year upon him whose Book is the best pillar.
Toward the Prophet of Allah, light of the age, pour blessing and peace every month.
Convey to the Select One, without blame, glad tidings that endure every day.
Illumine, by the rank of the Chosen One, my passage, my sitting-place, my dwelling and my piety.
By the right of Your noble Face forgive me, and all that weighs upon me expiate it from me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O Living (Al-Ḥayy) and O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), protect all of me.
Grant me the Supreme (Name) and the Book, and spare me the reckoning and reproach.
O Allah, bless for ever and grant peace upon him whom You made a ladder for me,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me, by his rank, vices before they head (for me), and lead virtues to me.
And gladden through me the whole of the elect, and save me from the harm of otherness.
And make the rest of my sojourn good, and spare me harm before it heads (for me).
O Allah, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), bless with peace him for whose sake this speech is (addressed) to You,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and the Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his immense rank, all of me a blessing, and my little the best of plenty.
And make my creeds illumined, and through him make all of me possessed of good things.
